A paddle on the left edge, a moving object spread across the interior, substantial previous-frame dependence, and no meaningful collectible map fit **Pong** particularly well. The policy would need to predict where a ball will reach the paddle's column.

Ordinary Breakout or a falling-object catching game would normally place the agent along the **bottom row**, not the left column. The weights cannot uniquely establish every game rule, but their spatial signature strongly favors a side-paddle ball-return game.
